mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MIX_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_RECORD (ID, SCHEDULE_TYPE, SCHEDULE_DATE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES (#{record.id,jdbcType= VARCHAR}, #{record.scheduleType,jdbcType= VARCHAR}, #{record.scheduleDate,jdbcType= TIMESTAMP}, #{record.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.createTime,jdbcType= TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT RECORD_ID, L.SCHEDULE_DATE, ORDER_NO, MACHINE_CODE, RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE, RECIPE_VERSION_ID, RECIPE_TYPE, PLAN_QTY, SHIFT_CLASS_ID, PRODUCE_ORDER, PUBLISH_RESULT, L.REMARK FROM T_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_LOG L INNER JOIN T_MIX_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_RECORD R ON R.ID = L.RECORD_ID AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE L.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND L.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND R.SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{scheduleType,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0 FROM T_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_LOG T INNER JOIN T_MIX_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_RECORD RT ON RT.ID = T.RECORD_ID AND RT.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE T.SCHEDULE_DATE = L.SCHEDULE_DATE AND T.MIX_AREA = L.MIX_AREA AND T.ORDER_NO = L.ORDER_NO AND T.PUBLISH_RESULT = L.PUBLISH_RESULT AND RT.SCHEDULE_TYPE = R.SCHEDULE_TYPE AND T.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND (T.CREATE_TIME > L.CREATE_TIME OR T.CREATE_TIME = L.CREATE_TIME AND T.ID > L.ID)) AND L.PUBLISH_RESULT = #{publishResult,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND L.DEL_FLAG = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MES_MIX_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT( SCHEDULE_DATE, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, MATER_CODE, RECIPE_TYPE, RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE, RECIPE_CODE, RECIPE_VERSION, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE ) SELECT r.SCHEDULE_DATE , r.BATCH_NO , r.ORDER_NO , r.glue MATER_CODE , RECIPE_TYPE , r.MACHINE_CODE , r.glue RECIPE_CODE , r.RECIPE_VERSION_ID , MID_PLAN_QTY NIGHT_PLAN_QTY , MID_PRODUCE_ORDER NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY DAY_PLAN_QTY , NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, #{dataVersion} DATA_VERSION , #{factoryCode} , #{companyCode} FROM T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT r WHERE r.id in #{id}
